verified_by: independent read-only verifier at b9f7e3a; lead removed the #61/#81 parks until their software halves (P06, P11) are fixed

rows.note: gate.lanes (daily) → lanes.route_certified reads pattern_count from certified family members in the DB and writes gate.lane_routed; _lane_capacity (release.py:5537) calls lanes.allocate/check_mix on measured job-seconds and boosts a starved lane's queued engineering priority; Worker.run_once → lane_hold → capacity.share_decision (capacity.py:170) holds an over-share lane job at the claim. STILL MISSING: sizes is not read from anything real — lanes._sizes_of (lanes.py:556) looks for CIR keys sizes/graded_sizes/grading.sizes that no CIR.to_dict emits (cir/model.py has no such field), so sizes==1 for every product exactly as before and the size-depth path stays unreachable; and capacity._slug (capacity.py:154) reads inputs.slug/product_slug, but cir.compile and gate.certify carry {"cir": {...}} so those two engineering job types are never lane-counted. With the 3-thread pool the lane limits are always {fast:1, flagship:1} (floor of 0.6/0.4 of one engineering worker), so the split numbers themselves are inert.

ops.dependencies (CADENCES daily, orchestrator grant, housekeeping band) → scale.dependency.act reads provider concentration from CostEntry (30d) and opens/resolves Incident anti-fragility:<axis> for EXISTENTIAL axes; ai_provider is load_bearing=True so real anthropic spend raises it. Runs through the worker in the test.

ops.capacity (weekly) writes detail.mix; capacity.latest_mix reads it (else BUILD_MIX); share_decision at every claim holds a job whose function already holds its budget while a starved function has runnable work (proved through Worker.run_once). Caveat (defect D3): function_budgets = max(1, floor(share*workers)); with the 3-worker pool every function's budget is 1 whatever the mix, so the mix is enforced only as 'at least one slot each', not as 30/30/30/10 or the distribution floor.

finance.governor (hourly) → governor._act_on_unit_cost (governor.py:561) reads unit_cost.unit_costs (CostEntry + gate.certified audits); ≥CA$5/30d with zero validated patterns opens Incident throughput-no-validated-output and lists unproductive agents; swarm.allocate (hourly) reads governor.unproductive_lanes and caps those lanes to 1 specialist. Below the floor it records measurable=False. Only the zero case acts; a falling ratio and contribution/dollar are reported, not acted on.

ops.thrash (hourly) → thrash_sweep writes suspension into Incident.detail; _progress computes progress/iteration and /dollar over all DONE jobs (free ones included); Scheduler.tick reads suspended_job_types and skips suspended/backed-off cadences (worker.py); JobQueue.requeue_dead reads retry_allowed and refuses a re-drive under the same build SHA. Defects D1 (backoff level grows per sweep with no new observation; deadline refreshed from now) and D2 (any new commit lifts the suspension) apply — see Codex P07/P08.

seasonal.engine (daily) → daily.run → radar.provenance.stamp_all stamps CultureObservation, InsightsSnapshot and now SerpSnapshot into trend_provenance; radar.scan (6h) enqueues radar.score, whose handler (pipeline.py) calls provenance.evidence_for → weight/check_presentable_as_current, multiplies the score, and the discounted score decides cir.draft promotion (proved through the worker). MISSING: MJs benchmark observations are still not stamped (stamp_all reads three tables, none MJs), which was half of the auditor's gap; concept↔evidence matching is substring-of-slug-words on topic (provenance.py:367), a heuristic.

listing.seo handler (enqueued by pricing.position in the chain) → release._support_knowledge (release.py:795) renders the FAQ from shop_package.faq_text + release facts, stores it as support_knowledge with lineage, extracts the produced PDF text and runs commerce.terms.consistency over PDF/listing/FAQ; divergence writes a P1 Incident with halts_publication and returns blocking so the chain stops. The consistent path is proved through the full worker chain; the divergent path is proved by calling _support_knowledge directly (not via the worker). shop_package.surface_consistency still has no runtime caller (terms.consistency is the one used).

launch.readiness (daily) → readiness.assess → brand.moat.inventory(db) → moat.evidence reads ArtefactProvenance/Listing/PatternVersion/AuditLog/PhysicalTest/Collection and the canonical_model gate, replacing the hand-set exists flags; brand_moat readiness is false unless every listing is 'recognisable'. MISSING: recognisability is not measured — it is `len(signatures) >= 3` (moat.py:198), a count of built artefact classes, with no independent judgement that a product-first frame reads as this brand; tutorial_voice is a constant False (honest). A real measurement needs a vision judge (image_vision) and could legitimately be parked there; the count should be labelled a proxy.

ops.dependencies (daily) → ops.dependencies.sweep: probes postgres (select 1 + continuity.verified within 2 days = recovery proved), model_provider/etsy_account/tester_network via executor gates, unmapped billed providers from CostEntry; a failed probe of a non-owner-only dependency or an unmapped provider opens Incident dependency:*, resolved when the probe recovers. Caveats: the railway probe is a constant ok=True (dependencies.py:240) and 4 dependencies have no probe (recorded UNKNOWN, honest); 'recovery strategy missing' is checked only for postgres.

launch.readiness (daily) → readiness._launch_package_items (readiness.py:697) computes digital_disclosure, support_knowledge, faq, pricing_promotion_plan, launch_calendar, analytics_baseline, rollback_plan per listing from DB rows; the hard-coded rollback ready=True and analytics_baseline=bool(listings) are gone. MISSING: analytics_baseline = listing.seo_score>0 plus any OperatingReading row of any kind (readiness.py:744), and rollback_plan = certificate retained plus a continuity.verified DB-restore proof ≤3 days — neither is a pre-launch traffic baseline nor a rehearsed withdrawal (Codex P12). And nothing downstream consumes readiness.ready except the launch.assessed audit, the owner queue (owner items only) and the /api readiness route, so a BUILD-blocked package item blocks no job.

assets.build → listing_assets.build_frames draws through _RecordingDraw (every text box recorded) and _paste (hero fabric, chart) into image.info.layout; check_frame_plan runs layout_qa.inspect on every non-hero frame plus layout_qa.check_layout (safe-area/title truncation, text-graphic collision, footer overlap, min pt) on every frame, and a problem is blocking for the chain. The handler-level collision test injects one layout entry into a real frame; the clean-build test proves the recorder produces layout (no LAYOUT_UNRECORDED). Only two graphics are recorded (hero fabric, chart); silhouettes drawn with primitives on the size card are not collision targets.

assets.build → release._review_frames (release.py:865) runs visual.inspect.inspect_image on every stored frame when the image_vision gate is open, compares the description to ROLE_CLAIMS, blocks the chain on a blocked frame, and writes assets.frame_review; store.publish → _listing_parity reads frame_review_state and sets blocks_release when any frame is not clear (unreviewed included). Gate is closed today, so every frame is UNREVIEWED and publication is blocked — honest. DEFECTS: ROLE_CLAIMS (release.py:857) covers only hero/size/chart/pattern_preview, so whats_included, materials and collection frames are reviewed against an empty claim and pass vacuously; release.py:888 converts unjudged→clear for any described frame; frame_review_state (release.py:920) returns reviewed=True for an audit whose frames map is empty; review is keyed by slug@version, not frame hash (Codex P06).

store.publish → _listing_parity → parity.assess(gate_open=gallery.gates_now(db)) reads image_generation/physical_proof live from executor gates; an open gate marks the first eligible rung taken and enqueues assets.owned/model_photography with reason parity_escalation:<rung> (pipeline.py:1629-1647). MISSING: the rungs are not distinct strategies — handle_owned_photography never reads reason/failed and its what_to_do_next refuses when a usable asset is on file or ATTEMPTS(3) are spent, so 'regenerate_constrained', 'change_composition' and 'change_tool' all enqueue the identical daily job (or a no-op); no rung attempt/result is persisted, start_attempt is always 0, so the ladder never advances past rung 1 (Codex P11). The gate-open proof monkeypatches gate.check, acceptable for an external gate.

seasonal.engine (daily) → daily.takeovers → takeover.execute (takeover.py:232) writes OperatingReading storefront.takeover rows APPLIED on transition date (after storefront.check_storefront on the resulting storefront; refused otherwise) and REVERTED on revert date; storefront.build_storefront(db) renders the live banner and launch readiness checks it. Marketplace write is withheld in shadow (honest). Caveat: only the banner surface reaches the rendered storefront (storefront.py:154); shop_content/featured_collection APPLIED state has no renderer.

gate.certify and launch.plan → teardown.lab.product_qa → compare_advantages (lab.py:357) against TeardownFinding rows of purchased benchmarks; parity_only → refused → _mark_withheld writes certificate.withheld on the PatternVersion row (fixes the persist-before-withhold bypass); listing.draft refuses, hourly chain.rebuild skips and targeted rebuild refuses withheld releases. No benchmark scored → UNMEASURED, recorded, non-blocking (the purchases are owner-gated). Codex P04 stands: an advantage is 'beyond' whenever the best benchmark scores <5 on the mapped dimension — capability presence, not a measured product score.

product_qa (at gate.certify and launch.plan) → lab.measured_self_scores (lab.py:193) scores all ten DELIGHT_DRIVERS (bonus_utility, navigation, customization, confidence added) from assets.build outputs, provenance and certificate; delight_question answers; _act_on_delight proposes one Improvement per weakest driver via improve.cells.propose (idempotent). Codex P05 stands: scores are fixed constants keyed on artefact presence (labelled measured_from_artefacts), provenance is read slug-wide across versions (lab.py:214), and customization reads a CIR 'sizes' key that never exists (always 3).

gate.certify → pipeline._persist_release records twin, geometry_proof (when the geometry stage ran) and reverse_result ArtefactProvenance rows keyed on cir fingerprint, with the certificate's parents naming them; listing.seo records support_knowledge; launch.plan → _record_release_bundle (release.py:1351) records release_bundle over its members. All through the worker chain; a CIR change now marks all of them stale for ops.sentinel.

ops.sentinel (hourly) → rebuild_graph.enqueue(per=product) enqueues chain.rebuild with product_slug, artefacts, fingerprints{old,new}, reason; handle_chain_rebuild → _targeted_rebuild (release.py:3068) reads them, enqueues the earliest REBUILD_STAGE (gate.certify/assets.build/pricing.position), writes chain.rebuild_requested per artefact, and a delayed verify job writes chain.rebuild_completed per artefact when provenance.check says FRESH, or a rebuild-incomplete Incident after 3 checks. marketing.schedule now remakes an existing ContentPiece on rebuild. Codex P10 partly stands: completion = 'row is FRESH now', not bound to the stage_job or to fingerprints.new; the marketing staleness exception matches the literal string '#172' in gate reasons (release.py:1408).

app.runner.start spawns BRAMBLELOOP_WORKER_THREADS (default 3) worker threads inside the single uvicorn process; each re-reads capacity.worker_target every 30s and stays dormant above the target; swarm.allocate (hourly) reads function (category), seasonal-deadline band pressure, proven-winner value and the ops.capacity bottleneck and writes workers.target on the SwarmAllocation; lane_hold can now hold because a second worker exists. Codex P09: admission is claim-then-check with a 60s hold, not a transactional reservation; no concurrent test.

finance.governor (hourly) records a parallelism observation (distinct live lease holders vs completions) per run and, with ≥2 distinct worker counts in 7 days, advises scale_up/scale_down; capacity.worker_target adds a worker on scale_up (bounded by pool) and lane_concurrency raises the lane limit by one; spend_by('experiment') now has a reader (detail.experiment → job.inputs.experiment → exploration:<job_type>). Codex P13 stands: the exploration:<job_type> label is a band proxy, not an experiment record.
